pipelines.name: ndid_data_collection
pipelines.description: Daily (T-1) pipeline collecting 3 NDID-related files from FTP (ndid_customer_journey, ndid_idp_request_log, ndid_unenroll_log). Validates checksums, stores raw copies to HDFS raw zone, then runs ETL in parallel per file: a Spark job for ndid_customer_journey, a safe/unsafe split for ndid_idp_request_log, and a straight passthrough for ndid_unenroll_log (no processing). Outputs land in the HDFS cleansed zone, are copied to the HDFS gold_safe zone, then loaded into Hive (prod_safe_mymo and prod_unsafe_mymo).
